prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: original League Reserve inline cost texticon, consumed at 18x18 pixels.
Primary request: Edit Image 1 only to improve value contrast at native size. Preserve the exact closed ledger/register silhouette, centered position, proportions, dark near-black outline, and single green vertical reserve stripe with its small center seal. Change the cover faces from near-black charcoal to a readable mid-tone pewter-grey; lift the stripe to a clearer muted emerald green. Keep neutral metal highlights and dark recesses, with no other accent hue. At 18x18, the book shape, outline, and green stripe must remain distinct against both light and dark backgrounds.
Input images: Image 1, native-alpha ImageGen League Reserve glyph, edit target.
Style/medium: crisp compact painted vanilla-style texticon, broad simplified forms and minimal interior detail.
Composition/framing: keep the exact centered object and transparent 18x18 unused canvas after processing; leave room for a one-pixel dark edge.
Lighting/mood: mild highlights on the grey cover, strong local contrast, no glow.
Color palette: mid-tone pewter-grey body, one muted emerald-green accent, neutral light-grey highlights, near-black outline and shadows.
Constraints: request genuine transparency and preserve transparent unused canvas; retain opaque subject surfaces. No letters, numerals, currency symbols, flags, extra symbols, gold accents, texture clutter, background, watermark, checkerboard, or matte.
Avoid: near-black cover faces that disappear on a dark panel, muddy green, softened outline, blur, halo, clipping, or added detail.
edit_delta: Brighten only the neutral cover faces and muted green accent for 18x18 contrast; preserve outline, silhouette, layout, and native transparency.
